remarks: Welcome to this bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 3.5-bath condo in one of Westport's most desirable communities! With nearly 2,700 sq. ft. across three levels, this rental offers comfort, style, and space in a peaceful, natural setting. The sun-filled main level features an open floor plan with a Living Room and Dining Room that both open to a wraparound deck-perfect for entertaining or relaxing among nature. The eat-in kitchen flows easily for everyday living. There is a half bath and a 2 car garage on this level as well. Upstairs, the generous primary suite includes a brand-new spa-like bath, while the second bedroom also enjoys its own private bath. The finished lower level adds wonderful flexibility, with sliders leading to a private patio plus a full bath. Enjoy southern exposure, tranquil views, and the convenience of a community pool and tennis court. Set in a quiet, private enclave just minutes from Westport's town center, beaches, and trains-this is easy living at its best!
